title: #043. Package Dependency Resolution (SAT)
subtitle: Resolve package versions under root requirements, dependency implications, and version conflicts while minimizing installed packages.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { feasible, selected, installedCount }.
judge.m1: When feasible is false, both selected and installedCount must be null.
judge.m2: A valid dependency resolution exists, yet feasible: false was returned.
judge.m3: selected["{p0}"] must be a version string or null (received {p1}).
judge.m5: Required root package "{p0}" was not installed.
judge.m7: Conflict violated: {p0}@{p1} and {p2}@{p3} cannot both be installed.
judge.m8: installedCount must be an integer matching the number of installed packages ({p0} vs {p1}).
judge.m9: Valid dependency installation, but installedCount ({p0}) exceeds minimum ({p1}).
